releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.39:
- On-Demand Customer Receipt Printing: Removed unprompted automatic receipt printing upon payment completion. Cashier is now prompted cleanly with "Print Receipt? (YES / NO)", eliminating duplicate receipts and paper waste completely.
- Restored High-Definition Thermal Receipt Logo: Verified Ticket #10003 high-contrast binary logo with bold silhouettes and deep black lines.
- Intelligent Can vs Bottle Barcode Scanner: Distinguishes between cans and bottles accurately for inventory tracking.
- Dedicated CUBETAS / BUCKETS Hub: Prominent amber BUCKETS card in BEER department with Domestic, Imported, and Mix & Match tabs.
- 100% Quality Standard: Passed all pre-flight simulator checks and integrity audits with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
